text: The purpose of this report is to recommend that City Council appoint one director to, and remove one director from, the Uptown Yonge Business Improvement Area (BIA) Board of Management.

City Council on January 31 and February 1, 2018, adopted the following: 1. City Council, in accordance with the City's Public Appointments Policy, appoint the following nominee to the Business Improvement Area Board of Management set out below at pleasure of City Council, and for a term expiring at the end of the term of Council or as soon as successors are appointed: Uptown Yonge: Cutruzzola, Adriana 2. City Council remove the following director from the Business Improvement Area Board of Management set out below: Uptown Yonge: Mainolfi, Tony
